inputs.goal: Add a clamp helper to src/stats.ts
inputs.work: Add and export `clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number): number` in src/stats.ts: return x limited to the closed range [lo, hi]. When lo is greater than hi, throw a RangeError. Add tests, including both bounds and a single-point range.
inputs.implementation_plan:
1. Add `clamp` to src/stats.ts: throw a RangeError when lo > hi, else return Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x)).
2. Add tests in src/stats.test.ts for inside, below, above, both bounds, a single-point range, negative and fractional bounds, and the RangeError.
inputs.implementation_summary: Added `clamp(x, lo, hi)` to src/stats.ts. It throws a RangeError when lo > hi and otherwise limits x to [lo, hi] inclusive. Tests cover values inside, below and above the range, both bounds exactly, a single-point range, negative and fractional bounds, and the RangeError. I ran the full suite and it passes, the new tests cover the behaviour and its edge cases, and the change is complete and verified; nothing else was touched.
